summary: Audit A4 (validation outside California) written to docs/redesign/audit-3/validation.md (about 270 lines). Fires outside California cannot be built today: the CLI, catalog and pipeline know CAL FIRE incidents only. Four more blockers would make the scores wrong even after that is fixed. (1) Perimeters are filtered to US-CA. (2) The UTM zone is only 10 or 11: Table Rock SC would get scale 1.127, area x1.27 and a 21.4 degree grid rotation. (3) 2024 fires get LF2024 fuels that already contain their own burn: 38-39 of 40 interior points changed, so LF2023 is needed. (4) The California live-fuel-moisture month table makes Windy Deuce's dormant February grass and Table Rock's March fuels 1.20/1.20 (green). Proposed: 10 primary fires, 2 per region for the Northwest, Northern Rockies, Great Basin and Southwest and 1 each for the Southern Plains and Southeast. Also proposed: 2 stretch fires (Rush OK, Black Cove NC) so every region can show a number if the user allows 12, and 5 reserves. Each fire has a proposed id, IrwinID, UniqueFireIdentifier, point and pre-registered UTC hindcast starts. Every primary fire was checked: 12-35 WFIGS polygon times, 280-1,955 quality VIIRS NOAA-20 detections in its main 5 days, 120/120 archived HRRR hours and the AOI size. Defined: a per-region accuracy label (GACC regions with the Southern Area split TX/OK vs the rest; mean of per-fire mean growth Sorensen of the 31-member p50, leads 12-72 h; a number only with at least 2 fires and 16 leads), plain-language wording for each case and a JSON data file shape.
verification: Gates not run: this role changes no code (orchestrator instruction).

WFIGS_Daily_Perimeters_Public: lists via outStatistics grouped by attr_IrwinID/poly_IncidentName/attr_POOState for 2024 and 2025, by state and by attr_GACC. Per-fire detail by attr_IrwinID gave records / distinct polygon times / days, e.g. Emigrant 46/26/24, Island Creek 53/35/35, Windy Deuce 17/12/8, Table Rock 23/22/10, Windmill 26/1/1, Johnson FL 26/1/1 (2026-10-22 21:05-21:20Z).
WFIGS_Incident_Locations: IrwinID IN (17 ids) returned 17 records (UFI, discovery, containment, size, GACC, point).

FIRMS fetch_area VIIRS_NOAA20_SP, one 5-day request per fire (counts only; key never printed), 21:24-21:35Z: Emigrant 1,955/16 scan times, Lower Sugarloaf 1,048/16, Island Creek 1,205/16, Horse Gulch 280/11, France Canyon 1,034/13, Cottonwood Peak 1,203/16, Trout 1,097/12, Greer 611/12, Windy Deuce 309/8, Table Rock 375/9, Rush 416/10, Black Cove 156/9, Johnson FL 0/0.

Open-Meteo historical-forecast gfs_hrrr+gfs_seamless, one point and 5 days per fire: 120/120 complete HRRR hours for all 18 fires checked. Daly failed twice with 429 and once with a cached HTTP-200 error body, which I evicted.

ERA5 water-year precipitation through sources.weather.water_year_precip plus moisture.live_fuel_moisture: Windy Deuce P=206 mm gives herb/woody 1.20/1.20; Table Rock P=459 mm gives 1.20/1.20; Trout, Greer and France Canyon give 0.60/1.00; the PNW/NR/GB fires give 0.30/0.70.

LANDFIRE getSamples at 40 interior points: Horse Gulch FBFM40 LF2023 vs LF2024 differs at 38/40 (canopy 8% to 3%); Windy Deuce differs at 39/40; Emigrant LF2024 vs LF2025 differs at 39/40 (canopy 52% to 38%). All LF2023 *_CONUS services exist.
pyproj get_factors in EPSG:32611 (what grid.utm_epsg_for picks): Trout 1.008/4.8 deg, Windy Deuce 1.023/9.0 deg, Table Rock 1.127/21.4 deg, Black Cove 1.129/21.8 deg.
GACC: the 3 California validation fires are all OSCC (WFIGS attr_GACC); DMP_NationalGACCBoundaries_Public lists 10 GACCs and has no licence text.
No bundle builds, no servers, no non-GET requests.
known_issues: Open-Meteo rate-limited the shared cloud egress (429s), and once answered HTTP 200 with an error body that fire3d.http caches for 30 days. Validation builds may silently fall back to ERA5 (G10/R7).
Daly (reserve): HRRR availability not confirmed because of the 429s. HRRR has been archived since 2018-01-01 per the Open-Meteo docs.

LANDFIRE terms were not re-checked (an existing source). The GACC boundary layer states no licence; its NIFC Open Data item must be checked before bundling it (recommended path: use WFIGS attr_GACC, an existing source).
The NFDRS 2016 GSI live-fuel-moisture recommendation (R5) is from knowledge of the method; its parameters must be verified against the NFDRS documentation by the implementing role.
Fire-to-fire spread makes 2-fire regional numbers rough; the label shows the range across fires and the number of fires.
